3.speaker: Narrator
3.text: After exchanging pleasantries, we were led inside. The light of the camera flashes nearly blinded us.

4.speaker: Axel Reinhart
4.text: "Welcome back, Your Majesty. It's a delight to have you here with us once again."

5.speaker: Narrator
5.text: I was here to finalize our deal with Duke Reinhart and Prime Minister Alvarez. Today, Rizia would officially cede its claim to the Aureus gas field.

6.speaker: Narrator
6.text: Upon our arrival to Castle Reinhart, we were greeted by the smiling faces of the Palesian and Lespian delegations as well as Duke Reinhart, who waited at the front gates.

7.speaker: Narrator
7.text: The city was familiar to me by now. But the atmosphere was far more welcoming than it had ever been before.

14.speaker: Narrator
14.text: I was here to sign our deal with Duke Reinhart as resolved by the AN. After today, Rizia would own 50 percent of the Aureus gas field.

15.speaker: Narrator
15.text: I was here to finalize our concession to Duke Reinhart, according to the AN's resolution. After today, Rizia's claim on the Aureus gas field would be officially null and void.

19.speaker: Narrator
19.text: Vina was already inside, standing next to the Palesian foreign affairs team. She came to me when we entered the hall.
19.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Pales_Vina_LeadsDeal"] == true) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_VinaManus_Approve"] == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_VinaManus_Approve"] == false) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Pales_PostIncident_Peace_Deal"] == true) == false)

21.speaker: Narrator
21.text: We took our seats around a large table along with the delegates from each country's ministry of foreign affairs.

22.speaker: Player_Romus
22.text: "You must be dying to return home. Thank you for accepting this duty, Vina. It means a lot."

23.speaker: Player_Romus
23.text: "Good to see you, Vina. How were the meetings? I'm told there are no issues."

25.speaker: Vina Toras
25.text: "Ha. Not when you put it like that."

26.speaker: Vina Toras
26.text: "They were long and arduous for sure. But honestly, it wasn't as boring as I'd have thought."

30.speaker: Narrator
30.text: For the third time since my coronation, our convoy drove steadily across the cobbled streets of Old Town Pales.

37.speaker: Narrator
37.text: I was here to sign our deal with Duke Reinhart as resolved by the AN. After today, Rizia would own 50 percent of the Aureus gas field.
37.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Pales_PostIncident_Deal_Cede"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Pales_PostIncident_Deal_25"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Pales_GasField_Buy"] == true) == false)

38.speaker: Narrator
38.text: I was here to sign our deal with Duke Reinhart. After today, Rizia would own 25 percent of the Aureus gas field. Not as much as I wanted, but better than nothing.
38.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Pales_PostIncident_Deal_Cede"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Pales_PostIncident_Deal_25"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Pales_GasField_Buy"] == true) == false)

39.speaker: Narrator
39.text: I was here to finalize our concession to Duke Reinhart. After today, the Aureus gas field would officially belong to the Grand Duchy of Pales.

40.speaker: Narrator
40.text: After exchanging pleasantries, we were led inside. The light of the cameras nearly blinded us as we walked in.

41.speaker: Narrator
41.text: Upon our arrival to Castle Reinhart, we were greeted by the smiling faces of the Palesian delegation as well as Duke Reinhart, waiting for us by the front gate.

42.speaker: Vina Toras
42.text: "Uh... I wouldn't exactly call it *dying*. But yes, thank you, Father. I did my best to offer support."

43.speaker: Vina Toras
43.text: "There were no issues with the agreement, and I'm told everything is ready for you to sign."

45.speaker: Player_Romus
45.text: "Thank you, Vina. You've done an amazing job."

46.speaker: Player_Romus
46.text: "Come on, then. Let's get this over with, shall we?"

47.speaker: Narrator
47.text: We were led into the conference room where the meeting was to take place.

51.speaker: Axel Reinhart
51.text: "I'm looking forward to settling this Aureus business and paving the way for a thaw between Pales and Rizia once and for all."

52.speaker: Axel Reinhart
52.text: "Today is not just about signing a deal. It's about laying the foundation for cooperation and mutual benefit between Pales and Rizia."

53.speaker: Player_Romus
53.text: "Thank you, Duke Reinhart. Your words mean a lot for me and our kingdom."

54.speaker: Player_Romus
54.text: "You are so kind, Duke Reinhart. Thank you for having us."

55.speaker: Player_Romus
55.text: "It is a pleasure to be here under such promising circumstances. This deal will mark a new chapter for both of our countries."

56.speaker: Player_Romus
56.text: "To be fair, I don't need a meeting with you to enjoy my visit to this great city."

57.speaker: Narrator
57.text: He started laughing along with everyone else at the table.

58.speaker: Axel Reinhart
58.text: "I must also thank your daughter. It's rare that a princess has such a knack for diplomatic intricacies."

62.speaker: Axel Reinhart
62.text: "I must also thank our partners in the Rizian delegation. They were instrumental in working out all the legal particulars."

64.speaker: Narrator
64.text: Vina blushed and bowed her head.

66.speaker: Axel Reinhart
66.text: "Rizia has agreed to cede half of its AN-acknowledged claim to the Aureus field to Pales, granting the Grand Duchy a 75 percent share in total."
66.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Pales_PostIncident_Peace_Deal"] == true) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Pales_DiplomaticArbitration_WonHalf"] == true) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Pales_PostIncident_Deal_25"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Pales_GasField_Buy"] == true) == false)

76.speaker: Axel Reinhart
76.text: "Both Rizia and Pales accept the Alliance of Nations' resolution. Ownership of the Aureus gas field will be divided evenly between our countries."
76.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Pales_PostIncident_Peace_Deal"] == true) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Pales_DiplomaticArbitration_WonHalf"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Pales_PostIncident_Deal_25"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Pales_GasField_Buy"] == true) == false)

80.speaker: Axel Reinhart
80.text: "Rizia has agreed to cede its claim to the Aureus gas field, in exchange for lasting peace between the kingdom and the Grand Duchy of Pales."

81.speaker: Axel Reinhart
81.text: "Both Rizia and Pales accept the Alliance of Nations' resolution. Pales will be granted sole ownership of the Aureus gas field."
81.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Pales_PostIncident_Peace_Deal"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Pales_DiplomaticArbitration_WonHalf"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Pales_ANDORArbitration"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Pales_GasField_Buy"] == true) == false)

91.speaker: Narrator
91.text: I was here to finalize our deal with Duke Reinhart. After today, Rizia would own the rights to the Aureus gas field -- and a fully operational pipeline to go with it.

101.speaker: Player_Romus
101.text: "I missed you, Vina. How was Pales?"

102.speaker: Vina Toras
102.text: "To be honest, I had a great time here."

103.speaker: Vina Toras
103.text: "Axel went above and beyond to make sure of it."

105.speaker: Player_Romus
105.text: "Did he? Don't fall for his theatrics. He's a snake through and through."

106.speaker: Player_Romus
106.text: "Good to know. I'm happy you had a good time here."

107.speaker: Player_Romus
107.text: "Be careful, Vina. It's *Duke Reinhart* and it will stay that way."

108.speaker: Vina Toras
108.text: "Oh God. What are you talking about?"

109.speaker: Vina Toras
109.text: "Oh come on, Father. It's not like that."

110.speaker: Vina Toras
110.text: "I think you have a very distorted perception of him."

112.speaker: Vina Toras
112.text: "I should show you around the Old Town before we leave. It's amazing how well-preserved it is, even in the middle of all the skyscrapers."

114.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
114.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLC.Pales_PostIncident_Deal_Cede"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Pales_PostIncident_Deal_25"] == true  or Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Lespia_GasField_25PercentDeal"] == true  or Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Pales_GasField_Cede"] == true

115.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
115.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Pales_PostIncident_Deal_Cede"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Pales_PostIncident_Deal_25"] == true  or Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Lespia_GasField_25PercentDeal"] == true  or Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Pales_GasField_Cede"] == true) == false

116.speaker: Player_Romus
116.text: "Yes, yes. Let's just get this over with."
116.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLC.Pales_PostIncident_Deal_Cede"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Pales_PostIncident_Deal_25"] == true  or Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Lespia_GasField_25PercentDeal"] == true  or Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Pales_GasField_Cede"] == true

117.speaker: Narrator
117.text: There was a brief silence as his expression soured.

119.speaker: Axel Reinhart
119.text: "Rizia has agreed to purchase the sole right  to extract resources from the Aureus Field."

123.speaker: Axel Reinhart
123.text: "Rizia has agreed to cede its claim to the Aureus gas field."
123.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Pales_PostIncident_Peace_Deal"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Pales_GasField_Cede"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Lespia_GasField_25PercentDeal"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Pales_GasField_Buy"] == true) == false)

134.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
134.text: "And Pales has agreed to give LesPower shared control over the field."

135.speaker: Narrator
135.text: Inside, we were greeted by the Lespian Prime Minister Alvarez and representatives from LesPower.

136.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
136.text: "It's good to see you, Your Majesty."

137.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
137.text: "In turn, Lespia will be granting extraction rights for one-quarter of the Aureus field to Rizian Oil and Gas."

138.speaker: Narrator
138.text: The assistants placed all the necessary papers in front of us to sign.

140.speaker: Narrator
140.text: The room broke into a lengthy round of applause.

150.speaker: Narrator
150.text: After exchanging congratulations, we were led outdoors into the courtyard, where a stage had been set up for the ceremony.

151.speaker: Narrator
151.text: We stood in front of a massive board with an illustrated map of the Antacean Sea, depicting the Aureus field as a bridge connecting Pales, Rizia and Lespia.

155.speaker: Narrator
155.text: We stood in front of a massive board with an illustrated map of the Antacean Sea, depicting the Aureus field as a bridge connecting Pales and Rizia.

156.speaker: Narrator
156.text: The stage itself was an outlandish construct, dominated by a towering replica of a drilling rig with a huge logo of LesPower on it.

157.speaker: Narrator
157.text: As we stepped onto the stage, the applause of the crowd blended with the loud music from the speakers and the clicks of camera shutters -- overwhelming me for a few seconds.

158.speaker: Narrator
158.text: Made to look like a sophisticated machine with oversized dials, levers, and flashing lights, it was less a piece of industrial equipment and more a prop from a science fiction movie.

165.speaker: Narrator
165.text: The stage itself was an outlandish construct, dominated by a colossal replica of a pipeline with a gigantic valve wheel at its center.

166.speaker: Narrator
166.text: The valve was painted in garish colors and connected to a series of exaggerated, cartoonish pipes that snaked their way across the stage, complete with artificial steam vents and blinking lights.

167.speaker: Narrator
167.text: The geysers were choreographed to erupt in unison with the crescendo of the music.

168.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
168.text: "I want to applaud you again, Your Majesty, for your decisive actions. We very narrowly avoided an international incident."

169.speaker: Player_Romus
169.text: "I get it, Laurento. You've thanked me enough already."

170.speaker: Player_Romus
170.text: "We couldn't have done it without your help, Mr. Esquibel."

171.speaker: Player_Romus
171.text: "You know I would have preferred a better deal."

173.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
173.text: "Sorry. I didn't mean to come across as a sycophant."

174.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
174.text: "No time to dwell on that now. We are here to celebrate."

175.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
175.text: "I want to applaud you again, Your Majesty. This was a tense situation, and I believe Rizia made the best of it."

176.speaker: Player_Romus
176.text: "I get it, Laurento. You've thanked me enough already."

177.speaker: Player_Romus
177.text: "So do I, Mr. Esquibel. Your advice and assistance was invaluable as usual."

178.speaker: Player_Romus
178.text: "You know I would have preferred a better deal."

180.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
180.text: "Sorry. I do realize how much you hate sycophants."

181.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
181.text: "No time to dwell on that now. We are here to celebrate."

186.speaker: Narrator
186.text: Her face gave way to a wide grin.

187.speaker: Narrator
187.text: We would also be inaugurating the opening of the Palestream pipeline, delivering gas from the field to Rizia on LesPower's terms.

188.speaker: Axel Reinhart
188.text: "We'll finalize the official details right now. Everything that happens afterwards is just for show."

190.speaker: Narrator
190.text: He gestured at the assistants in the room. They quickly placed enormous files on the table.

195.speaker: Player_Romus
195.text: "Well, a deal this important deserves a spectacle."

196.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
196.text: "It seems the Palesians went above and beyond for this ceremony."

201.speaker: Narrator
201.text: He pointed at a mock rig surrounding the stage. There were a series of artificial geysers, engineered to spout water and colored lights at timed intervals, simulating the dramatic discovery of natural gas.

204.speaker: Player_Romus
204.text: "Organizing this must have cost as much as the drilling facility itself."

206.speaker: Narrator
206.text: As the music came to an end and the applause subsided, I took a closer look at the crowd that was gathered.

207.speaker: Narrator
207.text: Politicians, journalists and energy executives in their best formal attire were standing somewhat awkwardly amidst this bizarre setting. They cast amused glances at the entertainers who mingled among them - performers dressed as engineers and geologists, complete with exaggeratedly large yellow helmets.

208.speaker: Narrator
208.text: Duke Reinhart then took the microphone and started explaining the importance of Aureus and the deal that had been finalized.

209.speaker: Narrator
209.text: After thanking and congratulating LesPower, he turned towards me.

213.speaker: Narrator
213.text: After congratulating the delegates and thanking me, he turned towards me.

217.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
217.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Incident_Naval_NoRescue"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Incident_Naval_FocusAidOnValero"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Incident_Border_KillSoldiers"] == true) == false

218.speaker: Axel Reinhart
218.text: "...And I invite His Majesty, King Romus of Rizia."
218.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Incident_Naval_NoRescue"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Incident_Naval_FocusAidOnValero"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Incident_Border_KillSoldiers"] == true) == false

219.speaker: Narrator
219.text: I took the microphone amidst the applause.

220.speaker: Player_Romus
220.text: "Duke Reinhart, my friend, I want to thank you from the bottom of my heart for your understanding and cooperation over these past few years."

221.speaker: Player_Romus
221.text: "Ladies, gentlemen, dear friends. I would like to thank Duke Reinhart for inviting us to attend this grand ceremony."

222.speaker: Player_Romus
222.text: "Mr. Reinhart, Mr. Alvarez, LesPower and ladies and gentlemen..."

226.speaker: Player_Romus
226.text: "Mr. Reinhart, esteemed delegates, ladies and gentlemen..."

227.speaker: Player_Romus
227.text: "Duke Reinhart, Prime Minister Alvarez. I want to thank you both from the bottom of my heart for your understanding and cooperation."

229.speaker: Player_Romus
229.text: "We are here to celebrate a truly significant event. A testament to our countries’ unbreakable bonds and ever-growing ambition."

230.speaker: Player_Romus
230.text: "Relations between Rizia, Pales and Lespia have reached a new peak. Our peaceful division of rights to the Aureus field reflects that."

231.speaker: Player_Romus
231.text: "Despite a recent deterioration of Rizian-Palesian relations, we have come together to achieve a historic agreement -- a testament to true diplomacy and our mutual desire for cooperation."

235.speaker: Player_Romus
235.text: "Despite attempts to divide our countries, we deliberately chose the path to peace and mutual growth."

236.speaker: Player_Romus
236.text: "Today, we have concluded a historic agreement, which is a testament to true diplomacy and our mutual desire for cooperation."

241.speaker: Player_Romus
241.text: "Relations between Rizia and Pales have reached a new peak. Our agreement regarding the Aureus field reflects that."

245.speaker: Player_Romus
245.text: "We are more than excited about the massive amounts of energy this gas field will produce."

246.speaker: Player_Romus
246.text: "Thanks to our cooperation with Pales, Rizia will soon be transporting billions of cubic meters of natural gas."

247.speaker: Player_Romus
247.text: "I am honored to announce the official agreement between our countries."

248.speaker: Player_Romus
248.text: "Let us not forget that, despite holding the right to claim part ownership of Aureus, Rizia decided to cede all of our rights to our partners in Pales."

249.speaker: Player_Romus
249.text: "In the name of peace and friendship, my kingdom selflessly gave away our claim to this massive new gas resource."

250.speaker: Player_Romus
250.text: "I am honored to announce the official agreement between our three countries."

255.speaker: Player_Romus
255.text: "I would like to note that extracting and transporting gas is not as easy as some may think. It will be a great undertaking."

256.speaker: Player_Romus
256.text: "This project has many benefits not only for our people and our country, but also for our neighbors and the region as a whole."

260.speaker: Player_Romus
260.text: [Gesture at the geysers] "Believe me, ladies and gentlemen, I am as shocked as every one of you."

261.speaker: Narrator
261.text: The crowd burst out in laughter.

262.speaker: Player_Romus
262.text: "This field will hopefully have many benefits not only for Pales and its people, but also for its neighbors and the region as a whole."

263.speaker: Player_Romus
263.text: "Thanks to the support and professionalism of LesPower, the project is already being implemented in a timely manner."

267.speaker: Player_Romus
267.text: "Thanks to the support and professionalism of our Palesian counterparts, future energy deals will be completed in a flash."

269.speaker: Player_Romus
269.text: "I am certain that in the future, Rizia and Pales will implement many more mutually beneficial joint projects, whether in energy or other fields."

270.speaker: Player_Romus
270.text: "I must point out that we live in a volatile region, with conflicts over resources, ideology and religion brewing on all fronts. Let Rizia and Pales serve as an example to all those around us."

271.speaker: Player_Romus
271.text: "It is my intention that Rizia continue on the path of peaceful conflict resolution. We will remain one of the most reliable trading partners in Merkopa."

272.speaker: Player_Romus
272.text: "I would like to congratulate the Palesian leadership for displaying the political courage and will to accomplish this extraordinary partnership."

274.speaker: Player_Romus
274.text: "Before I finish, I would like to highlight the importance of Palesian-Rizian friendship to Southern Merkopa."

275.speaker: Player_Romus
275.text: "Before I finish, I would like to highlight the importance of Lespian-Rizian friendship to Southern Merkopa."

279.speaker: Player_Romus
279.text: "Before I finish, I would like to highlight how important it is for the monarchies of Merkopa to stick together."

280.speaker: Player_Romus
280.text: "I won't bore you all for much longer. I know you want to see what happens when we turn that wheel."

282.speaker: Player_Romus
282.text: "We must not forget. Major powers like us have a responsibility to our region. Today, we are showing the world that we take our duties seriously."

283.speaker: Player_Romus
283.text: "Prime Minister Alvarez and I have had our differences in the past. I hope this agreement will go some way towards mending those fences."

284.speaker: Player_Romus
284.text: "The Kingdom of Rizia believes in strengthening its cooperation with the member states of the ATO. There is so much we can gain from each other."

286.speaker: Player_Romus
286.text: "Both of our countries are important exporters of natural resources. I believe energy giants like us have a responsibility to the region. And today, we are showing the world that we take our duties seriously."

287.speaker: Player_Romus
287.text: "Duke Reinhart and I have had our differences in the past. I hope this initiative will go some way towards mending those fences."

288.speaker: Player_Romus
288.text: "The Kingdom of Rizia sees the people of Pales as our brothers and sisters. Let today be a step towards unity between us."

290.speaker: Player_Romus
290.text: "Both the Rizian and Palesian monarchies are important exporters of natural resources. I believe energy giants like us have a responsibility to the region. And today, we are showing the world that we take our duties seriously."

291.speaker: Player_Romus
291.text: "In these turbulent times, the guiding hand of a king or a queen -- or a Duke or a Duchess -- is more necessary than ever. We shall prove to the world exactly what we are capable of."

292.speaker: Player_Romus
292.text: "We see the Grand Duchy of Pales as a potential future GRACE member, and a powerful ally. Let today be a step towards that."

295.speaker: Player_Romus
295.text: "Now... Let the inauguration of the Palestream pipeline begin!"

297.speaker: Player_Romus
297.text: "As a closing word, I would like to thank everyone who has worked so hard on the design and construction of this gas pipeline: the engineers and builders, as well as the employees of all the contractors involved."

298.speaker: Player_Romus
298.text: "Now... Let the inauguration of the Aureus drilling rig begin!"

299.speaker: Player_Romus
299.text: "As a closing word, I would like to thank everyone who has worked so hard on the design and construction of this drilling facility: the engineers and builders, as well as the employees of all the contractors involved."

301.speaker: Player_Romus
301.text: "As a closing word, I would like to thank everyone who has worked so hard on reaching a resolution on Aureus. This is an asset for the entire region."

302.speaker: Player_Romus
302.text: "I wish success to all of you and to all of us in the future."
302.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn06_AureusDeal_DrillingOpening"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn06_AureusDeal_PipelineOpening"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn06_AureusDeal_PipelineOpening"] == true) == false)

306.speaker: Player_Romus
306.text: "Before I finish, I would also like to say a few words about the tragic events that occurred recently."

307.speaker: Player_Romus
307.text: "It is a sad reality that misunderstandings and lack of communication led to the loss of lives. But we must put this behind us and look ahead."

308.speaker: Player_Romus
308.text: "Thanks to the conciliatory attitude of Duke Reinhart, we managed to reach an agreement in time to avoid further bloodshed."

309.speaker: Player_Romus
309.text: "The Kingdom of Rizia believes in compassion. We not only forgave each other, but also reached a historic resolution."

310.speaker: Player_Romus
310.text: "I am still deeply saddened by the loss of life that occurred. We must never forget this incident."

312.speaker: Player_Romus
312.text: "Thank you and have a good evening."

316.speaker: Narrator
316.text: The crowd roared with applause. I gave the microphone back to Duke Reinhart.

323.speaker: Narrator
323.text: He shook my hand and gestured for Prime Minister Alvarez to join us.

324.speaker: Narrator
324.text: As the moment of the ceremonial valve-turning approached, we walked to the massive valve in the middle of the stage and placed our hands on it, posing for the cameras as we did so.

325.speaker: Narrator
325.text: Instead of the expected mechanical hum, the speakers erupted with the sound of whistles and party horns. The music swelled and the geysers went off in unison, enveloping the area in a colorful mist.

326.speaker: Narrator
326.text: As the main event approached, a gigantic faux control panel was wheeled onto the stage. The panel, festooned with blinking lights and oversized buttons, was set for the ceremonial ‘activation’ of the gas field.

327.speaker: Narrator
327.text: Duke Reinhart and Prime Minister Alvarez were guided towards the panel, where they were handed gloves to operate the machinery.

328.speaker: Narrator
328.text: Duke Reinhart, Prime Minister Alvarez and I were guided towards the panel. We placed our hands on it, posing for the cameras as we did so.

329.speaker: Narrator
329.text: With a theatrical flourish, they pressed the buttons and the mock rig came to life. The music swelled and the geysers went off in unison, enveloping the area in a colorful mist.

330.speaker: Narrator
330.text: There was a series of industrial sounds as the mock rig came to life. The music swelled and the geysers went off in unison, enveloping the area in a colorful mist.

331.speaker: Narrator
331.text: After a few more minutes of picture-taking, we left the stage.

332.speaker: Narrator
332.text: I couldn't help but feel relieved once we were finally out of Pales.

342.speaker: Narrator
342.text: Upon our arrival to Castle Reinhart, we were greeted by the smiling faces of the Palesian and Lespian delegations as well as Duke Reinhart, waiting for us by the front gate.

343.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
343.text: "Lespia and LesPower are incredibly pleased that your nations have reached a mutual understanding."

344.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
344.text: "We will assume shared control over three-quarters of the field, while Rizian Oil and Gas will control the remaining 25 percent."

345.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
345.text: "The contract for extraction and transportation of Palesian gas has been given to our state corporation LesPower."

346.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
346.text: "Rizian Oil and Gas will control the rights to the Rizian half of the field, while Lespia will share control over the Palesian half."

347.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
347.text: "Extraction and transportation from that half of the field will be carried out by our state corporation LesPower."

348.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
348.text: "From this point on, the extraction and transportation of Palesian gas will be handled by us."

349.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
349.text: "And LesPower of Lespia will receive the sole right to extract resources from the field."

353.speaker: Narrator
353.text: After me, the documents were also passed to Prime Minister Alvarez. As soon as he finished signing, the room broke into a lengthy round of applause.

358.speaker: Narrator
358.text: Prime Minister Alvarez then took the microphone and started explaining the importance of Aureus and the deal that had been finalized.

359.speaker: Narrator
359.text: After a brief introduction, he gave the microphone to Duke Reinhart. The Palesian leader made his own brief speech before turning towards me.

361.speaker: Player_Romus
361.text: "You must be desperate to get back and see Manus. As I promised, you may announce your courtship at once."

365.speaker: Vina Toras
365.text: "Manus... Yes, of course. Thank you so much, Father."

366.speaker: Narrator
366.text: As she spoke, her gaze inadvertently traveled to where Duke Reinhart was standing.

392.speaker: Narrator
392.text: In the car, I glanced over at the PAR Aureus Plaque, a celebratory gift from the Rizian Oil and Gas Corporation, sitting snugly on the seat next to me.

396.speaker: Narrator
396.text: The city was familiar to me by now. But the atmosphere was much more cheerful and cordial than it had been during my last visit.

397.speaker: Narrator
397.text: For the second time since my coronation, our convoy drove steadily across the cobbled streets of Old Town Pales.

402.speaker: Player_Romus
402.text: "The best? We lost what should rightfully belong to us!"

403.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
403.text: "But we avoided an international incident. That's something to be proud of."

410.speaker: Player_Romus
410.text: "But at what cost? Lespia's getting the gas that should belong to us."

411.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
411.text: "If we play nice with both nations, we could yet claim a greater share of the rights."

416.speaker: Narrator
416.text: Vina was already inside, standing next to the Palesian foreign affairs team. She ran to me the moment I entered the hall.

418.speaker: Vina Toras
418.text: "Father! I can't tell you how good it is to see you again."

419.speaker: Player_Romus
419.text: "I am so, so sorry for what I put you through."

420.speaker: Vina Toras
420.text: "There were some scary moments. But I never actually believed Axel would let anything happen to me."

421.speaker: Player_Romus
421.text: "Did anyone hurt you? You can tell me."

422.speaker: Vina Toras
422.text: "I'm just fine. Axel and the Palesians took good care of me the whole time."

423.speaker: Player_Romus
423.text: "Thanks for your hard work despite the unpleasantness."

424.speaker: Vina Toras
424.text: "Ehm... you're welcome. I was just doing my diplomatic duty."

428.speaker: Player_Romus
428.text: "I thank the good Lord that you are safe."

429.speaker: Vina Toras
429.text: "I was never in any real trouble. Axel and the Palesians made sure I was taken care of."

430.speaker: Player_Romus
430.text: "This was your greatest challenge as a princess yet, and you passed with flying colors."

434.speaker: Player_Romus
434.text: "Nearly losing you made me realize how much your happiness means to me. Once we're back in Rizia, we'll announce your relationship with Manus straight away."

435.speaker: Narrator
435.text: She gave me a quick hug.

436.speaker: Vina Toras
436.text: "The houses will be fine with it. You'll see."

441.speaker: Player_Romus
441.text: "I'm just grateful that the culprit has been jailed and we can put this whole mess behind us."

442.speaker: Vina Toras
442.text: "I still can't believe Duchess Azaro would sabotage our deal like that. She's every bit as war-hungry as the stereotypes"

446.speaker: Vina Toras
446.text: "The incident slowed things down, of course, but my Palesian counterparts and I managed to get the paperwork into shape. All you have to do is sign it."

450.speaker: Player_Romus
450.text: "You've earned the right to gloat. Mr. Prime Minister. You and Reinhart won fair and square."

451.speaker: Player_Romus
451.text: "Indeed. I'm happy we managed to see through the nefarious forces trying to set us against each other."

452.speaker: Player_Romus
452.text: "Energy really is the great unifier, isn't it?"

453.speaker: Narrator
453.text: The smile dropped from his face.

454.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
454.text: "I'll say. And there's more than enough in the Aureus field to go round."

455.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
455.text: "Your own showing wasn't half bad, Your Majesty. You had us worried for a moment."

456.speaker: Player_Romus
456.text: "What did your friend Dwight have to say about all this?"

458.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
458.text: "I'll drink to that. After the ceremony, obviously."

462.speaker: Player_Romus
462.text: "I'll drink to that. What about you, Alvarez?"

465.speaker: Player_Romus
465.text: "To the extraordinary opportunities Aureus will bring."

467.speaker: Player_Romus
467.text: "It's a good thing Mother's not here. Wouldn't want her getting ideas for her next outfit."

471.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
471.text: "She would definitely appreciate... whatever that is."

475.speaker: Player_Romus
475.text: "Making a mockery of God's wonders... who do they think they are?"

485.speaker: Narrator
485.text: He shook my hand and beckoned me to follow him.

486.speaker: Narrator
486.text: He shook my hand and smiled appreciatively as I was ushered into the wings. Prime Minister Alvarez triumphantly took my place.

490.speaker: Narrator
490.text: As the moment of the ceremonial valve-turning approached, the three of us walked to the massive valve in the middle and placed our hands on it, posing for the cameras as we did so.

492.speaker: Narrator
492.text: Instead of the expected mechanical hum, the speakers erupted with the sound of whistles and party horns. The music swelled and the geysers went off in unison, enveloping the area in a colorful mist.

494.speaker: Player_Romus
494.text: "Get Princess Vina up here. This honor belongs to her as well."

495.speaker: Narrator
495.text: My daughter eagerly bounded up to the stage. Together, the three of us turned the wheel.

499.speaker: Narrator
499.text: Through the fog, I noticed Vina and the Duke of Pales grinning at each other.

500.speaker: Player_Romus
500.text: "Get Princess Vina up here. This honor belongs to her as well."

504.speaker: Narrator
504.text: My daughter eagerly bounded up to the stage. Together, all four of us turned the wheel.

508.speaker: Narrator
508.text: We stood in front of a massive board with an illustrated map of the Antacean Sea, depicting the Aureus field as a bridge connecting Pales and Lespia.

510.speaker: Player_Romus
510.text: "Get Princess Vina up here. This honor belongs to her as well."

514.speaker: Narrator
514.text: My daughter eagerly bounded up to the stage. She, Reinhart, Alvarez and I each pressed one of the buttons.

515.speaker: Narrator
515.text: With a series of industrial sounds, the mock rig came to life. The music swelled and the geysers went off in unison, enveloping the area in a colorful mist.

519.speaker: Narrator
519.text: After a few more minutes of picture-taking, they left the stage.

526.speaker: Player_Romus
526.text: "Together, we identified and punished the responsible party, enabling us to mend our relations and turn over a new leaf."

530.speaker: Player_Romus
530.text: "My father King Valero was wrong to mistrust Lespia. With Mr. Alvarez at the helm, I believe the Republic will be a valuable partner to us in the future."

534.speaker: Player_Romus
534.text: "My kingdom believes that our partnerships with our neighbors are our greatest asset. We shall continue to foster those partnerships, even at the expense of our own wealth."

541.speaker: Player_Romus
541.text: "I won't bore you all for much longer. I know you want to see what happens when we turn on that rig."

542.speaker: Player_Romus
542.text: "I can see you are getting impatient. I will bring my speech to a close."

545.speaker: Narrator
545.text: He looked at me with a sly smile.

546.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
546.text: "As a gesture of gratitude for the magnanimity of King Romus, we shall also fund the construction of a pipeline from the Aureus field to Rizia. With the volume and price of gas deliveries to be agreed on -- or not -- at a later date."

554.speaker: Narrator
554.text: I was here to finalize our deal with Duke Reinhart. After today, Rizia would own the rights to the Aureus gas field -- and a fully operational pipeline to go with it.
